levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Learner asked the core question but recorded only a one-line answer with no follow-up.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Learner asked the core question and at least one follow-up grounded in the person's answer.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Learner's follow-up surfaced a specific detail (a cost, a timeline, a skill) not covered by the warm-up assumption.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Write-up restates the original assumption without engaging what was actually said.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Write-up explicitly states whether the conversation confirmed, corrected, or complicated the assumption.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Write-up explains specifically which part of the assumption was wrong or incomplete and why.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Reflection states 'nothing changed' with no reasoning given either way.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Reflection gives a specific reason the shortlist did or did not change.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Reflection identifies a specific next step (a question to research, a person to ask) prompted by the conversation.

lookFors: The warm-up assumption is a genuine, specific belief, not a placeholder like 'I don't know much about it.'
The write-up directly references something the real person said, not a generic restatement.
Only first name and pathway-related questions were shared, per the safety notes.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
